sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.1877 of 2009
Order:

This writ petition is filed seeking the following prayer:
"to issue any appropriate writ order or direction preferably a writ in the nature of Mandamus declaring the action of the respondents in not denotifying the excess land of 30 sq. yards situated in premises bearing Municipal No.36240/A Himayatnagar,
Hyderabad belonging to the petitioner as illegal, arbitrary and violative of Article 14 and 300A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondents to confine the acquisition in terms of the 4(1) Notification issued under Land Acquisition Act to an extent of 93 sq. yards in premises bearing Municipal No.3-6-240/A Himayatnagar, Hyderabad belonging to the petitioner and pay compensation to an extent of 93 Sq. yards by denotifying 30 sq. yards situated in premises bearing Municipal No.3-6-240/A Himayatnagar, Hyderabad belonging to the petitioner pending disposal of the above writ petition and to pass orders".
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the respondents are not denotifying the excess land of 30 sq.yards to the land acquisition notification issued as per Land Acquisition Act to an extent of 93 sq.yards bearing Municipal No.3-6-240/A, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad belonging to the petitioner.

Initially, the State was intending to acquire 121 sq.yards but actually the need was completed with 93 sq. yards approximately and 30 sq.yards is not at all being used for the road widening, the petitioner is ready to take compensation only to an extent of the road widening i.e. 93 sq. yards approximately and requested to denotify by the excess land of 30 sq.yards situated in Municipal bearing No.3-6-240/A, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad by allowing the Writ Petition.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos.1 and 2, basing on the counter submits that a draft Notification and draft declaration has been published on 14.02.2008 and 15.02.2008 respectively.

The Assistant City Planner, Circle No.3,
presently Circle No.9 has placed the requisition for an extent of 93.33 sq.yards in premises bearing Municipal No.3- 6-240/A, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad.

During the survey and preparation of Sub Division Records in respect of premises bearing Nos.3-6-240 and 3-6-240/A being a joint property pertaining to the petitioner's brothers and herself demarcated and prepared Sub Division Records to an extent of 122.25 sq.yards.
After filing of writ petition, the affected area has been inspected along with concerned Assistant City Planner and Survey Team.

The Survey and Sub Division Records earlier also re-verified and found that the affected area in respect of house bearing Municipal Dr. Minakshi Devi vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70832345/
1 No.3-6-240/A comes to 93.33 sy. yards only.

In view of the Re-survey of the land acquisition of the petitioner's property will be confirmed to 93.33 sy. yards only and the compensation will be paid only for 93.33 sq. yards only and requested to pass appropriate orders.

5. After hearing both sides on record, this Court is of the considered view that the petitioner initially issued land acquisition proceedings notification and declaration of the land to an extent of 122.25 sq.yards and after filing of writ petition as per the counter filed by the respondents conducted re-survey and re-verified the records and found that the affected area in respect of the house bearing No.3-6- 240/A comes to an extent of 93.33 sy.yards only and land acquisition proceedings will be confirmed to 93.33 sq. yards only and compensation will be paid for 93.33 sq.yards only.
6.

In view of the same, this writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondents to confine acquisition in terms of 4 (1) notification issued under Land Acquisition Act to an extent of 93 sq.yards and de-notifying the excess land of 30 sq. yards situated in premises bearing Municipal No.3-6- 240/A, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad belonging to the petitioner and directing the respondents to pay the compensation for the land acquisition to an extent of 93.33 sq.yards in premises Municipal bearing No.3-6-240/A, Himayatnagar, Hyderabad along with accrued interest as per Section 34 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 within two (02) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
7. Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

_ _ ________ JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:15.04.2024 Dsu Dr. Minakshi Devi vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70832345/
